Hockey.et: Borrowed from English hockey. The archaic pronunciation in /-aɪ̯/ is a spelling pronunciation; the now usual form in /-e/ is also influenced by the spelling.

Höcker.et: Umlauted variant (16th c., perhaps from a plural and/or the adjective höckerig) of older Hocker (15th c.), itself an intensified form of Hoger, from Middle High German hoger, from Old High German hogar (12th c.). Related with Hügel and hoch.
